title: 183. Maximum Frequency Stack

examples.explanation: Push 5, 7, 5, 7, 4, 5. Frequencies are 5:3, 7:2, 4:1. Pop returns 5 (most frequent), then 7 (tie between 7:2 and 5:2 broken by recency), then 5, then 4.
Push 4, 6, 4. Pop returns 4 (freq 2), then 6 and 4 tie at freq 1 so recency pops 6 then 4.

hints: Track each value's frequency and group values by frequency in stacks.
Keep the current maximum frequency; push appends to its frequency group and pop removes from the max group, decreasing max when empty.
